note: The Virginia Department of Elections database lists a Virginia Beach City Mayor contest on 2018-11-06 (contest 134283), titled General Election, with Dyer 82,201, Davenport 75,693, write-ins 833, total 158,727. Charter 3.02:2 sets mayoral elections in November every fourth year, so 2018 is off cycle. Charter 3.03 has the council choose a mayor after a vacancy until a successor is elected. No official source that was opened states that a vacancy occurred or that the 2018 contest was a special election. Re-checks failed: the city sites vbgov.com and vbelections.vbgov.com returned a connection error or no relevant text, and the web search budget was used up. The year is marked unresolved because the election_type cannot be established from an official source. The results record is removed for this reason. The vote totals above are from the state source.
